title: An AI Assistant for Automating Anti-Corruption Expertise of Draft Legislation Based on the TRACE Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.14244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). translated_title: 基于TRACE框架的法案反腐败专家审查自动化AI助手
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个基于TRACE架构的AI助手，用于自动化法案草案的反腐败专家审查，旨在筛查法案中的腐败风险：精确定位专家会批评的条款，并指出每一条款中存在的监管缺陷。该处理流程结合了确定性解析核心、模型引导的单一条款定性、基于规则的风险因子分配以及外部人工监督。为了评估该助手，我们根据乌克兰国家反腐败预防署（NAZK）公布的审查结论构建了一个开放基准，包含132项法案草案和474个模型提取的发现。当系统标记指向兼容的条款，且由LLM评判者将风险评级为相同（严格标准）或部分相同（宽松标准）时，即认为该系统标记与发现一致。在100项法案草案上，使用本地Gemma 4 31B模型时，该流程在其前十个标记中匹配了0.28的发现，使用Sonnet 5.5时为0.30，而在……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文基于TRACE架构提出了一种自动化反腐败专家审查的AI助手，能够筛查法案草案中的腐败风险并精确定位专家会批评的问题条款，同时利用乌克兰国家反腐败预防署的公开结论构建了首个开放评估基准。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a TRACE-based AI assistant that automates anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation by screening bills for corruption risks and pinpointing criticisable provisions, evaluated on an open benchmark constructed from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK).
